content: Vaultwarden unlocks Bitwarden's paid org/collections/sharing/TOTP/emergency-access features for free on self-host. Bitwarden's org model (orgs -> collections -> groups -> role-based access) is enterprise-shaped; for a family of 4 it's overkill vs a lightweight shared-vault/collection model. Cost comparison: self-hosted family setup is cheaper than Bitwarden Families (.88/yr) from year one.
